name: Opera Neon
tagline: Opera's subscription agentic browser — built to act, not just browse.
insight: The $19.90/month subscription bundles premium third-party model access — Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5.1, Veo 3.1, and Nano Banana Pro.
description: An agentic AI browser from Opera built around three agents: Neon Chat answers with page and history context, Do executes tasks directly on web pages, and Make generates mini-apps, sites, and documents. Tasks group related tabs and chats into workspaces, Cards package repeatable prompt workflows, and the ODRA agent compiles sourced deep-research reports. Opened to the public in December 2025 after an invite-only waitlist.

modelSupport.notes: LLM-agnostic engine; the subscription bundles premium models such as Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5.1, Veo 3.1, and Nano Banana Pro.

edge: Agent-first where rivals bolt chat onto browsing — Do acts on live pages and Make builds mini-apps, beyond the sidebar-assistant browsers.
pros: Chat, Do, and Make agents built in
Premium frontier models in one subscription
cons: $19.90/month where rival AI browsers are free

references.title: Opera wants you to pay $20 a month to use its AI-powered browser Neon
